answer_1.quote: We evaluate our method on diverse tasks from open speculative decoding benchmarks, as well as on a set of applications vital to on-device AI assistants, including Text Summarization using DialogSum dataset, Structured Query Generation using SqlCreateContext dataset constructed from WikiSQL and SPIDER, and Meaning Representation using E2E-NLG dataset.
answer_1.outputs: generated text responses, SQL queries, dialog summaries, and meaning representations

answer_2.quote: For the structured query task, we use Exact Match (EM) accuracy, while for Dialog Summarization and Meaning Representation tasks, we report ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-LSum scores.

answer_3.quote: On MT-Bench, we evaluate response quality using GPT-4-graded scores that assess coherence, correctness, and engagement. We conduct our experiments using FastChat, which incorporates GPT-4 evaluation.
